description: This source file defines services related to fetching and mocking match data for a dating app frontend. It includes a data model 'MatchItem', an abstract service interface 'MatchService', and a mock implementation 'MockMatchService' that returns predetermined match entries based on query parameters.

classes.name: MatchItem
classes.description: A simple data model representing a match entry.

classes.name: MatchService
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for fetching matches based on query filters.

classes.name: MockMatchService
classes.description: A mock implementation of MatchService for testing purposes, returning deterministic data.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches a list of MatchItem objects based on provided query parameters.
